mapper.insert: INSERT INTO refund ( refund_no, order_no, member_no, refund_status, refund_reason, total_refund_amount, requested_at ) VALUES ( seq_refund.NEXTVAL, #{orderNo}, #{memberNo}, 'REQUESTED', #{refundReason}, 0, SYSTIMESTAMP )

INSERT INTO refund_item ( refund_item_no, refund_no, order_item_no, refund_quantity, refund_amount, refund_status, created_at ) VALUES ( seq_refund_item.NEXTVAL, #{refundNo}, #{orderItemNo}, #{refundQuantity}, #{refundAmount}, 'REQUESTED', SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT order_item_status FROM order_item WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} ORDER BY order_item_no ASC
